questions.question:
In this question, three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusion(s) logically follows/follow from the statements.

**Statements:**

All rings are earrings.

Some rings are chains.

All chains are bangles.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some rings are bangles.

II. Some earrings are bangles.

III. Some chains are earrings.

options.text: All conclusions I, II and III follow.
Both conclusions II and III follow.
Both conclusions I and II follow.
Both conclusions I and III follow.

questions.solution:
The least possible venn diagram is shown below,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/da17b0d94b70da0fbfdf4c5f9360e19cffbfd616745c8440f47cb9564c2b6663.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some rings are bangles → **True** (All rings are earrings, some rings are chains and all chains are bangles implies that some part of rings which are chains are also bangles).

II. Some earrings are bangles → **True** (All rings are earrings, some rings are chains and all chains are bangles implies that some earrings which are chains are also bangles).

III. Some chains are earrings →** True **(All rings are earrings, some rings are chains and all chains are bangles implies that some chains which are rings are also earrings).

Hence, the correct answer is **"All conclusions I, II and III follow"**.

questions.question: If 6 May 2005 is a Friday, then what will the day of the week on 25 September 2018?
questions.solution: **Given:** 6 May 2005 was Friday. Now, 2005 to 2018 = 13 Years (10 Ordinary Years and 3 Leap Years). And, In 13 Years = 3 Leap years and 10 Ordinary Years. So, 3 Leap Years have 6 odd days, And, 10 Ordinary Years have 10 odd days. Total odd days = 6 + 10 = 16.

questions.question: If 15 December 2006 is a Friday, then what will the day of the week on 13 October 2009?
questions.solution:
Given: **15 December 2006** was Friday.

Now,

2006 to 2009 = 3 Years (2 Ordinary Years and 1 Leap Year).

And, In 3 Years = 1 Leap year and 2 Ordinary Years.

So, 1 Leap Year has 2 odd days,

And, 2 Ordinary Years have 2 odd days.

Total odd days = 2 + 2 = 4.

then, 15 December 2009 will be Friday + 4 = Tuesday.

Now, the number of days between 15 December 2006 to 13 October 2009

= 16 (December 2006) + 365 (2007) + 366 (2008, leap year) + 286 (days from Jan to Oct 13, 2009) = 1033 days.

= 1033 days → 1033/7 = 147 weeks and 4 odd days.

So, **13 October 2009** will be Friday + 4 = Tuesday.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
